create.name: Gordon Burnham
create.bio:
Gordon Burnham is an American musician, poet and meditation teacher rooted in the Vedanta tradition of Swami Paramananda. Raised in Michigan, where he studied psychology and music, he settled on the south shore of Boston and from 1976 spent twenty years as music director of the Vedanta Centre in Cohasset under Srimata Gayatri Devi, who gave him the spiritual name Jaidev. During that time he was also on the music therapy staff at Northeastern University in Boston and, with the encouragement of Joan and Miron Borysenko, released his first album and began co-leading workshops with Joan in centres around the country.

He is now based in La Crescenta, California, where he leads music and speaks regularly at Ananda Ashrama. He leads kirtan, the call-and-response chanting of Sanskrit mantras and prayers from Hindu, Buddhist and Native American traditions, and gives talks on contemplation, surrender and finding peace within. His guided meditations, which pair breath awareness and visualisation with quiet music, are on Insight Timer. His books include a year of daily verses and reflections, a practical meditation handbook, and several collections of contemplative poetry written in the grounds of the ashram.

books.title: Inspirations & Meditations: 365 Daily Verses and Reflections
books.author: Gordon Burnham
books.description: One page for each day of the year, pairing a short poem drawn from nature or from Rumi, Hafiz, Emerson and others with a reflection grounded in Vedanta and other world teachings. It is written to be spiritual without belonging to any one religion.

books.title: Meditation Tips 'n Techniques: Simple Methods, Guides & Aids
books.author: Gordon Burnham
books.description: A practical handbook of simple meditation methods for beginners and seasoned meditators alike, with help for getting past common obstacles and a plain account of the thinking behind the practice.

books.title: Whispers of Light
books.author: Gordon Burnham
books.description: A collection of short contemplative poems on nature and spirit, several of which he also reads on his guided-meditation album.

books.title: The Mystical Dance
books.author: Gordon Burnham
books.description: Devotional and mystical poetry written out of his years of practice in the Vedanta tradition.

books.title: Something the River Says
books.author: Gordon Burnham
books.description: Poems of spiritual awakening drawn from time in nature and quiet reflection, in the same spirit as his daily verses.

books.title: Spirit of the Mountain
books.author: Gordon Burnham
books.description: Short inspirational writings composed in the grounds of Ananda Ashrama in the foothills above La Crescenta.

courses.title: Kirtan and Sacred Chant Concerts
courses.description: Gordon leads evenings of call-and-response chanting in Sanskrit and other traditions for spiritual centres, churches and groups; no musical experience is needed to join in. Bookings are arranged one by one.

courses.title: Spiritual Talks
courses.description: Talks for groups and centres on themes such as contemplation, letting go, the power of the mind and finding peace in hard times, booked individually.

free_resources.title: Gordon Burnham on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided meditations on Insight Timer, using breath, mindfulness and visualisation set to soft background music.
